value.transport: Explicit user or release import of a supported offline basemap package.
value.statement: qtiles_geonical produces completed raster MBTiles/ZIP but does not publish it automatically; confirmed MBTiles replacement happens only after successful export and preserves the prior file on cancel/failure, temporary .qtiles files are not import artifacts; the Android consumer accepts the unchanged tiles/metadata raster MBTiles contract with Web Mercator tile matrix, supported image format, zoom range and bounds, without sharing a desktop workspace path; vector MBTiles are out of scope. Legacy Debug-to-Geonical raster transfer remains a distinct signed read-only ContentProvider/URI stream, unrelated to the removed vector HTTP server. Client phase/elapsed/cancel changes do not alter desktop basemap formats or Debug originals; actual large-transfer acceptance is pending.
